title: review follow-ups of PR #37783
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups the contract records of PR #37783 left to the seat) · Source: fleet (PR #37783, records 7209785394 and 7210318602)

## What happens

PR #37783 retires an agent's `model.provider`. Its contract review records left three points outside that PR:

- **`model.topP` has no carrier card.** The liveness ledger still reads `topP DEAD`, and no open issue carries it. It needs a card where its reader would live, or its retirement on the same route as `provider`.
- **The cloud side of the prescription.** The new guidance says the deployment resolves a model name among the providers it has turned on. That is objectstack-ai/cloud#5055 phase 1, and it must be true by the release that carries the tombstone. The review did not read cloud.
- **No producer census in cloud.** A built-in agent in cloud that still writes `model.provider` fails `tsc` or the parse when cloud bumps the spec pin. That is loud, but it belongs in the pin bump's plan.
- **PR body (N4, nit).** The merged PR body's Verification list still reports `check:empty-changeset` at 0, and its What-changes list does not name the top-level `AgentSchema` guidance the delta commit added. Record only; nothing to change on `main`.

## Expected

- A carrier card for `model.topP`, or a retirement card, filed against the ledger row.
- The cloud owner of the pin bump knows the two cloud points before the release that carries the tombstone.

## Done when

- [ ] `model.topP` has a card that names its route (enforce or remove).
- [ ] The cloud pin bump's plan names cloud#5055 phase 1 and a census of `model.provider` writers.

Grade: area:ai · Feature · n/a · reach: the agent spec's dead `topP` key, and cloud's next spec pin bump · evidence: the two review records above
